newsitem.title: UK: GWR to launch in-house ad sales company.
newsitem.headline: GWR to launch in-house ad sales company.

text.p: UK commercial radio company GWR Group Plc said on Wednesday it was launching its own in-house advertising sales unit.
The decision follows Capital Radio Plc's decision to cease operating its national sales subsidiary Media Sales and Marketing (MSM) in the wake of its proposed acquisition of Virgin Radio.
GWR said the move to go it alone would give the company control of all its revenue streams.
The new unit will represent all GWR stations and will be structured in such a way as to maintain GWR's national Classic FM station as a separate brand.
GWR reported pre-tax profit of 11.9 million stg in the 12 months to end March 1997, more than double the previous year.

GWR, which acquired Classic FM for 83 million stg last August, said it was confident of profit growth this year. It noted that the advertising market had pulled up following a slowdown before the May 1 election.

GWR chief executive Ralph Bernard told reporters Classic FM was now profitable for the first time in its short history. He noted that James Capel was forecasting profit of 5.6 million stg from the unit this year.
He said Classic FM's loss-making Swedish arm would be sold and that its operation in Finland was likely to go the same way.
